kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتحابب (form VI)
# نَتَحَابَبُ (nataḥābabu) /na.ta.ħaː.ba.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَابَبَ (taḥābaba)
# نَتَحَابَبَ (nataḥābaba) /na.ta.ħaː.ba.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَابَبَ (taḥābaba)
# نَتَحَابَبْ (nataḥābab) /na.ta.ħaː.bab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَابَبَ (taḥābaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
